decisions.reason: It builds on the firm's ergonomic task lighting expertise and its dedicated web presence indicates early results are interpretable, so related knowledge supports keeping it.
General interior lighting is squarely within the firm's core building lighting domain, giving it strong absorptive capacity to assimilate and improve the product.
As a flagship pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics, it directly extends the firm's optical and energy-efficient LED direction, making it a high-priority keeper.

Marine HMI searchlights depend on older non-LED and marine-specific knowledge outside the firm's LED-focused core, limiting the firm's ability to learn from and improve them, so the firm drops them to redirect resources.
